lifecycle.limits: One natural idle interval per arm, three forced restarts per extension; separate profiling experiment. Restart latency includes the extension UI/message/readiness path.

public.limits: Live network/content varies, only three observations per cell, incomplete position balance; no account sign-in. Failed/unready pages remain unscored. Public feed-host freeze was added after the controlled runs; the byte-exact controlled harness remains archived.

decision.reason: WardenOne has higher controlled page task time but lower peak native private memory in these settings; browser CPU differences are smaller. Products protect different surfaces, and public page variability, small samples and one-machine scope prevent a universal performance result.
decision.optimization: Reviewed exact-source feed budgets restore real updates. CPU profiles identify initialization paths, but no isolated correctness-preserving CPU optimization was established in this phase; no security feature was removed to improve cost.

retainedFailures: Original reference warm-up quarantined the over-cap AdGuard source; URLhaus download-source cap also exceeded.
First preflight rejected mutable fetch metadata as data drift; semantic payload projection retains actual source pins and active filter bodies.

Initial full gate exposed a fixture missing the new source-limit constant; fixture dependency added, assertions preserved. The rate-limit suite failed under concurrent preflight load and passed isolated; the final gate is isolated.
First lifecycle attempt incorrectly required fresh reconciliation after worker wake; native rules persist, and the corrected diagnostic verifies them directly.
First public attempt exposed an automatic feed update before CDP network freezing; the launch-time feed-host freeze kept warmed data stable in the retained preflight.

Second public attempt observed WardenOne updating per-site toastMemory after displaying a service-worker warning; the final settings comparison excludes that visit history while retaining all protection settings.
